notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
In this update, you are waiting for such changes and innovations:
Previously, some cameras have been placed in such positions that when using VR - users can not see the screen. - Corrected.
Removed invisible objects on the level.
Fixed achievement.
Added pause menu.

Stay with us and participate in the development of the project, together with the developer!
